name: Electric go-kart

seo.title: Electric Go-Kart Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Electric go-karts on Koh Lanta: small and large karts, single or double seats, 10 or 15 minute sessions, plus koi fish feeding. From 399 THB.

lead: Race electric karts on a track, alone or in a double seat, then feed the koi fish. Sessions of 10 or 15 minutes.

facts.label: Karts
facts.value: Small single seat, small double seat, large single seat, large double seat

included: The kart for the length of the session

beforeYouBook.pickup: Need a ride to the track? Ask us for a transfer.

faq.a: 10 or 15 minutes, on a small or a large kart.

faq.q: Can two people share a kart?
faq.a: Yes. The double-seat karts take two people, small or large.

legacyText.title: Electric Go-Kart Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: There are four kinds of kart: small single seat, small double seat, large single seat and large double seat. Pick the one that fits your group, then the length of the session.
The price list is for a minimum of 2 programmes.
legacyText.cardDescription: Small and large electric karts, single or double seats, and koi fish to feed.

dayItems.text: Small single seat, small double seat, large single seat or large double seat.
Feeding the koi fish is part of the visit.

goodToKnow: Need a ride to the track? Ask us for a transfer.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht, for a minimum of 2 programmes.
legacyText.caption: Electric karts
